name: TC-084: Global alert banner appears after threshold crossing then auto-dismisses within 15 seconds
description: Posts density=450 which exceeds the saved Traffic Density > 100 threshold. The backend pushes a WebSocket alert to the AppComponent which renders .global-alert-banner with a message and an OK button. The banner must then disappear on its own within 15 seconds (AppComponent setTimeout ~5s). If still visible after 15s the OK button is clicked to clean up before failing.
